bounded_slice: Compare the candidate against one public primary-source reconciliation/version pattern and one O read-only request/control snapshot; do not mutate O and do not attempt the previously blocked synthetic probe.

observed_semantics: status.conditions[].observedGeneration records the metadata.generation on which a controller condition is based; a lower observedGeneration means status is stale relative to desired state
metadata.resourceVersion identifies persisted resource versions and supports tracking updates from a known version
public_primary_source.scope: Public analogue for generation-aware desired-state reconciliation plus version-aware concurrency/change tracking; it does not prove this Chat/repository mechanism is implemented end-to-end.

observed_semantics: persisted invocation_id and manifest_digest/request/source content digests
frozen_request_rule keeps an exact manifest for replay
source-clock change produces a new manifest and new request identity
result publication policy uses expected-blob CAS for state-only updates
o_read_only_source.scope: One persisted O request/control snapshot. It shows identity, generation-like clocks, replay freezing and CAS ingredients, but not a general desired-generation/observed-generation reconciliation object for arbitrary superseding mutable effects.

dedup_result.reason: The candidate's core desired-generation/observed-generation plus version/CAS reconciliation shape is isomorphic at the mechanism level to a standard controller pattern already documented by Kubernetes.
dedup_result.relative_to_o_reason: O already contains request identity, source clocks/lease generation, frozen replay and expected-blob CAS ingredients. This bounded slice did not verify an O-wide arbitrary-mutable-target desired-generation/observed-generation reconciliation protocol, so absence cannot be generalized from the single snapshot.

exact_next_candidate: At the next fresh invocation, compare the unresolved delta only: whether an O-wide mutable-target reconciliation object binds desired generation/request digest, persisted observed generation/result digest and current-blob CAS so a retry after supersession can deterministically no-op, advance exactly once, or fail closed. Prefer a direct O read-only schema/protocol source; if no such generalized protocol is found within one bounded slice, preserve relative_to_o=unverified rather than infer absence.
